notices.title: Visit to the National Security Exhibition Gallery of the HKSAR (11 Nov 2026)
notices.summary: The notice announces a whole-day visit on 11 November 2026 to the National Security Exhibition Gallery at 2/F, Hong Kong Museum of History, 100 Chatham Road South, Tsim Sha Tsui, with school-bus transport, school uniform and stationery required, and a lunch-arrangement reply due by 4 November 2026.

notices.title: Distribution of Competition Notification for Speech Festival
notices.summary: The Speech Festival Competition Notification will be given to participating students the next day and must be kept for competition day, with alteration forms to be returned by 2 November 2026 and video submissions, where applicable, from 10:00 a.m. on 30 October to 5:00 p.m. on 5 November 2026.

notices.title: Payment for Dental Care Service (only for e-enrolled students)
notices.summary: Parents of e-enrolled students pay $45 for the Department of Health dental care service via an SMS payment notification bearing ID #DH-PAYMENT through the Department of Health e-Payment Portal; reply on or before 30 October 2026.

notices.title: Recruitment of Lunch Helpers (Nov 2026 – Feb 2027)
notices.summary: Recruitment of Lunch Helpers, November 2026 to February 2027, duty 12:50–1:20 p.m. on regular school days; reply on or before 30 October 2026.

notices.title: Invitation to Parent Talks (November) – Jockey Club Family Resilience Project Re「抗逆有家」家長學堂
notices.summary: Free online Parent Talks in November 2026 (5, 16 and 17 November) under the Jockey Club Family Resilience Project; reply on or before 2 November 2026.

notices.title: MSS MPS Centenary Raffle Tickets Sale
notices.summary: Return the completed reply slip (hard copy), payment, raffle ticket stubs and unsold tickets on or before 23 November 2026.

notices.title: Invitation to “Star Reading” Chinese Story Writing Competition （「星靈伴讀」中文故事創作比賽）
notices.summary: Reply slip option selected: my daughter will not join the Chinese Story Writing Competition.
